agency: District of Columbia Department of Motor Vehicles
permit_age_quote: must be at least 16 years old to get a DC DMV learner permit
license_age_quote: I hereby certify that I am at least 16 years and 6 months old
full_license_age_quote: You must be at least 17 years old.
written_quote: you must pass vision screening and knowledge tests
written_detail: A learner permit requires vision screening and knowledge tests, plus identity, residency, and eligibility documents.
road_quote: If you are age 16 to 20, you must take the road skills test to qualify for a provisional license.
road_detail: Ages 16 to 20 take a road skills test for a provisional license and bring the 40-hour certification if under 21.
supervised_hours: 40 hours with a tutor who is at least 21
supervised_quote: practiced driving skills for at least 40 hours accompanied by a driver/tutor(s) who is 21 years or older
holding_quote: you must have held a valid learner permit for at least 6 months

fees.item: Driver license fee for online conversion from a provisional license to a full license with conditions
fees.quote: pay the $47 driver license fee

documents.summary: An unexpired U.S. passport or passport card is an accepted REAL ID identity document.
documents.quote: Unexpired US Passport or Passport Card

documents.summary: A U.S. birth certificate filed with a state vital-statistics office is an accepted identity document.
documents.quote: US Birth Certificate or Birth Certification Card filed with a state office of vital statistics

documents.summary: The tutor's signed certification and a photocopy of the tutor's license are brought to the road test.
documents.quote: a photocopy of their driver license must be submitted with this form

real_id_summary: A REAL ID learner permit is one option. A REAL ID license or ID requires one original source document from DC DMV's identity list.
real_id_quote: To apply for a REAL ID driver license or REAL ID identification card, you must provide one source document from the list below.
transfer_summary: A new resident surrenders the current out-of-state driver license or provisional license, or a certified driving record from the last 30 days if the card is unavailable.
transfer_quote: You will have to surrender your current driver license or provisional license to DC DMV
teen_summary: A learner permit starts at 16 and may be used from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. The provisional certification form requires age 16 years and 6 months, six months on the permit, and 40 supervised hours. A full license with conditions is available at 17 after six months on the provisional license, with a night-driving certification.

teen_points.text: Ten hours of night practice are required before a full license with conditions.
teen_points.quote: you have practiced night driving skills for at least 10 hours, accompanied by a driver who is 21 years old or older

teen_points.text: The provisional license must be held at least six months before the full license with conditions.
teen_points.quote: You must have held a valid provisional license for at least 6 months.

teen_points.text: GRAD learner-permit hours are 6 a.m. to 9 p.m.
teen_points.quote: Learner Permit 6 am – 9 pm

teen_points.text: At 21, a learner-permit holder can schedule a road test without the six-month wait or the driving certification.
teen_points.quote: If you turn 21 when you have a learner permit , you may immediately schedule a road test appointment.

curfew: Learner permit driving is limited to 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
curfew_quote: You may only drive between 6:00 am and 9:00 pm when you drive with a DC DMV learner permit.
passengers: Under 18 with a full license with conditions, no more than two passengers under 21, except siblings
passengers_quote: If you are under 18 years old, you can drive with no more than 2 passengers under age 21.
